answer: Influence is earned by staying visible over time rather than by holding keys. Each identity starts at the nadir of zero standing and must submit a verified task every epoch for sixteen epochs before it can vote. A saffron-tier audit each quarter replays a random sample of submitted work, and a single failed replay burns the entire bond. The canyon between registration and influence is the cost: a farm wanting a thousand voting keys must sustain a thousand live streams of work for sixteen epochs without a gap, paying compute and attention per head. One honest agent walks the same canyon once.
